data.title: Egide shareholders back broad capital powers, reject employee plan
data.description:
Egide SA ( (FR:ALGID) ) has issued an update.

Egide SA shareholders approved all but one of the resolutions presented at the combined general meeting held on 10 September 2026, including the 2025 financial statements, regulated agreements and a share buyback authorization. The meeting also confirmed iXcore Group’s co-optation to the board, set directors’ remuneration and updated the board’s composition under chairman Philippe Bensussan.

A broad suite of capital-related authorizations was granted, allowing the board to pursue various share capital increases with or without preferential subscription rights, free share and stock option plans, and potential capital reductions via cancellation of treasury shares. One proposal to reserve a capital increase for members of an employee savings plan was rejected unanimously, highlighting shareholder caution over dilution while still providing management with substantial financial flexibility ahead of the October half-year results.

data.title: Manulife Financial Sets Terms for US$750 Million Subordinated Notes Due 2041
data.description:
An update from Manulife Financial ( (TSE:MFC) ) is now available.

On September 11, 2026, Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K in the United States to report a Second Supplemental Indenture under its existing subordinated indenture first established in 2017. The filing reflects Manulife’s ongoing use of U.S. and Canadian trustees to structure subordinated debt offerings that qualify under Canadian capital rules, underscoring the company’s active management of Tier 2 capital and long-term funding.

The Second Supplemental Indenture, dated September 11, 2026, establishes a new series of 6.146% subordinated notes due 2041 with an initial aggregate principal amount of US$750 million.
